cases.seed_rule: q0: saved source has generator=A with separate V/A draws; q1..7:195+query
cases.prompt: pick up the milk and place it in the basket
cases.selection_criterion: Simultaneous left/right fingerpad contact AND >2cm lift in each of five consecutive control-step records.

No network patch, new training, inferred intention, q0 target commitment or neural-root-cause claim.
